I am identifying distinct enforcement sites that control memo visibility across the server surfaces.

Eleven potential enforcement sites were identified, including API permission checks, attachment serving, RSS, frontend rendering, SSE, email and user notifications, reactions, attachment service, user stats, and memo mention helpers. The major HTTP and RPC surfaces appear to be the gRPC memo service, file server, RSS, and frontend.

The distinct enforcement sites are now enumerated. They include APIV1 GetMemo and ListMemos filters, fileserver attachment permissions, RSS and frontend public-only queries, SSE canReceive, email and inbox notification access checks, attachment binary API, and reactions.

Searching for the GetMemo visibility check function. Also reviewing attachment API, list comments, share tokens, and stats for enforcement sites.

Seven distinct enforcement sites were identified:

- API memo access check — memo_service.go
- ListMemos visibility filter — memo_service.go
- File server attachment serving — fileserver.go
- RSS feeds — rss.go
- Frontend sitemap — frontend.go
- SSE delivery — sse_hub.go
- Email notifications — notification/email.go

Five additional enforcement sites were found:

- Inbox notifications — user_service_notifications.go
- Attachment API — attachment_service.go
- Reactions — reaction_service.go
- Memo attachments list — memo_attachment_service.go
- User stats — user_service_stats.go
- Mention notifications — memo_mention_helpers.go

Store-layer SQL filters were excluded because they are not server surfaces.

Checking comments listing, MCP, reaction_service, and GetMemo as additional enforcement sites for memo visibility.

Found six distinct enforcement sites so far. These include checkMemoReadAccess, ListMemos, checkAttachmentAccess, checkAttachmentPermission, RSS VisibilityList, and frontend sitemap. Still searching for the seventh.

More enforcement sites found: SSE client access, email notification access, reaction service visibility, attachment listing, user stats, and mention context helpers. The full list is being grouped by major independent server surface.

Twelve distinct enforcement sites are now fully mapped. The list includes checkMemoReadAccess, ListMemos, checkAttachmentAccess, checkAttachmentPermission, RSS, frontend sitemap, SSE canReceive, email notification access, inbox notification access, reaction_service, user stats, and memo_mention_helpers.

Checking whether reaction_service reuses checkMemoReadAccess or enforces its own visibility check. Comments and MCP surfaces are also being reviewed to avoid duplicate listings.
